description: Work out interest on a money judgment from the rate and dates you send. Send the judgment amount, the yearly rate in percent (the rate your statute or the judgment sets; for a federal judgment, the 1-year Treasury rate for the week before the judgment under 28 U.S.C. 1961), the date interest starts and the date to count to, and choose simple interest or interest compounded yearly (the federal rule), monthly or daily, and a day count of 365, 360 or actual days in each year. Optional partial payments are applied first to interest, then to the amount owed (the United States Rule). Get back the days, the interest, the amount due, the interest per day from the end date, a year-by-year schedule and how each payment was applied. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/interest-judgment-calc). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

annual_rate_percent.description: Yearly interest rate in percent (4.25 for 4.25%), from your statute, the judgment, or the federal weekly 1-year Treasury rate.

day_count.description: Days in a year for the daily rate: 365 (default), 360, or actual (366 in a leap year, each day at its own year's rate).

end_date.description: Date to count to (the payoff date), YYYY-MM-DD.

judgment_amount.description: The amount interest runs on (the judgment, or the part of it that bears interest).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. a matter number up to 6 digits (your own text, echoed; not a party name).

method.description: simple (default; many state statutes), compound_annual (28 U.S.C. 1961(b): computed daily, compounded annually), compound_monthly or compound_daily (only if your rule says so).

payments.description: Optional partial payments (up to 100), each applied on its date: first to interest owed, then to the amount owed.

date.description: Payment date, YYYY-MM-DD (after start_date, on or before end_date).

start_date.description: Date interest starts (usually the date the judgment was entered), YYYY-MM-DD.

name: interest_judgment_calc
title: Post-Judgment Interest Calculator
